items.title: Reddit stock tumbles the most on record as lack of new AI deals, US daily users metric disappoints
items.summary: Reddit shares plunged the most on record on Friday after US daily users, lack of new AI deal announcements dissapointed investors.

items.title: Apple stock plunges: CEO Tim Cook explains weak revenue forecast
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) stock is moving lower after the company's revenue forecast fell short of Wall Street's expectations. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley chats with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about what's driving the stock and guidance lower.

items.title: Apple is growing without the AI spending spree engulfing Big Tech: Chart of the Day
items.summary: Apple is growing like an AI spender but isn't spending like one. Thursday's earnings show that route may be cheaper — but it's not free of obstacles.

items.title: Insurance ETFs Top Defensive Sector Chart In July As Investors Look To Pivot Slightly From Chips And AI
items.summary: Insurance ETFs are garnering attention as a defensive play as investors look to hedge against tech and AI.

items.title: Beyond the Mag 7: Rising Q3 Estimates Signal a Market-Wide Earnings Expansion
items.summary: Companies that have reported in the Q2 cycle are offering encouraging reads on order trends, margin resilience, and full-year demand. This fundamental health is filtering directly into analyst models, driving a steady stream of upward revisions for Q3 and beyond.

items.title: Silicon Valley loves young founders. Until it doesn’t.
items.summary: AI tools have democratized the opportunity to build, shortening the timelines of success and enabling more young people to start successful companies without stepping foot inside a Big Tech company.

items.title: Amazon and Apple Deliver the Drama to Close a Turbulent Month
items.summary: A surge in  Amazon  stock Friday gave the Nasdaq enough momentum to obscure  Apple  slump.  Beneath the surface of the Nasdaq composite’s 1% gain was a tug of war between Apple stock, which fell 7.4%, and Amazon’s which surged 15%.  The post-earnings slide, Apple’s largest since 2014, followed company forecasts for its September quarter that fell short of Wall Street’s expectations.

items.title: Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, Micron, Roblox, Reddit, SK Hynix, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  It shaped up to be a positive end to a bad month for stocks. The tech rebound continued, even as a big decline from Apple weighed on the major indexes.  Amazon gained 15% after second-quarter earnings and revenue comfortably beat expectations.
